task_definition.task_description: Please check the weather in Tokyo, book flight CA1234 for Alice Chen in economy, and then look up the Hilton Tokyo, prepare a deluxe room stay for Alice Chen from 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-14, get its stay sheet, and publish that stay sheet to Alice in the app with high priority. After that, scan the living room devices, select the thermostat and set it to 22°C in eco mode, then lock the main door lock with PIN 2026.

user_input.query: Please check the weather in Tokyo, then book flight CA1234 for Alice Chen in economy. After that, look up the Hilton Tokyo and arrange a deluxe room stay for Alice Chen from 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-14, get the stay sheet, and publish that stay sheet to user_id alice in the app with high priority. Then scan the devices in the living_room, choose the thermostat, and set it to 22°C in eco mode. Finally, set lock_main to lock and use PIN 2026 to lock it.
